# Workshop

`shot.usda` composes `lighting.usda` and `layout.usda`. Layout references three
instances of `model.usda`, each with a different `finish` selection. The model
composes `looks.usda` and loads its geometry from the `geometry.usda` payload.
`lookdev.usda` references the same model for an individual asset inspection.

Change the finish variant, unload/reload the model payload, inspect individual
layer sources in Window → Code, or export the shot with its dependencies. The
geometry and material layers remain separate in the authored files.

Generated by `scripts/generate-production-texture-fixtures.py`. All art is original.
